## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` is green
- [ ] The PR title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the squash commit and decides the release)
- [ ] README / SPEC updated if behaviour, fields or errors changed
- [ ] No tokens, `Authorization` headers, `auth.json` content or real billing responses anywhere (code, tests, fixtures, description)
